title: AI Integrity: A New Paradigm for Verifiable AI Governance

bias_targets.methodology: Using forced-choice benchmarks grounded in the Schwartz theory of Basic Human Values to measure the consistency of an AI model's value hierarchy across varying scenarios and detect 'Integrity Hallucination' (value inconsistency).

Using forced-choice benchmarks based on Walton Argumentation Schemes and GRADE/CEBM evidence hierarchies to measure and evaluate how an AI systematically selects and weights different types of evidence.
Using forced-choice benchmarks derived from Source Credibility Theory to measure an AI model's source preferences and detect opaque or selective source weighting.
